trials.name: room-camera

diagnostics.method: Mutual SIFT ratio matches, source depth confidence above per-view 40th percentile; predicted poses project source pixels into the next view.
diagnostics.note: Image correspondence consistency only. Repeated textures, moving objects, calibration and occlusion can affect this diagnostic.

trials.warning: Tentative visible-scene hypothesis. Shape and camera alignment may be wrong. Unseen room boundaries remain unknown.
trials.confidence_note: Faint amber points include the lower 40% of depth confidence or farthest 1% of depth; rankings are not calibrated accuracy probabilities. All displayed geometry also depends on uncertain camera poses.
